sources.quote: It has the variable star designation BU Tauri and the Flamsteed designation 28 Tauri.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 95 times the Sun's luminosity at 7,548 K, so 5.695 solar radii.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Pleione (star)"
sources.quote: Pleione is located close on the sky to the brighter star Atlas, so is difficult for stargazers to distinguish with the naked eye despite being a fifth magnitude star.
